references.text: Moses' father-in-law Jethro warned him that he could not bear the people's burden alone, a recurring theme about the weight of leadership
Moses repeats that he cannot carry the people alone and describes the burden as too heavy for one person
God's response to Moses' complaint by distributing the Spirit among seventy elders to share the burden
Jethro's advice to share leadership so the burden becomes easier to bear
Elijah expresses similar exhaustion and a feeling of being alone in his service
The apostles realize they cannot carry all tasks alone and choose helpers to share the ministry
